newsitem.title: PERU: Argentine-led group buys Peru electric distributor.
newsitem.headline: Argentine-led group buys Peru electric distributor.

text.p: The Hica consortium, led by Argentina's Iate SA, bought at auction Tuesday state-owned Peruvian electricity distributor Electro Sur Medio for $51.28 million, according to privatization officials.
The officials said the Hica consortium beat offers from three other bidders to buy the unit, which operates in the southern departments of Ica, Huancavelica and Ayacucho.
The consortium also includes the local companies C. Tizon P. SA, Amauta Industrial SA, S&Z Consultores Asociados SA and Constructora Vasquez Espinosa SA.
The Hica group is also committed to making the necessary investment to increase electricity availability to a further 65,000 inhabitants in poor areas of its operating zone, the officials added.
